about: Most important AAC words first. Each entry is one modern flat picture to generate, with the exact scene so the meaning is unambiguous for a minimally verbal child. Words already drawn in modern flat are skipped automatically. 'wordTiles' are grammar words that cannot be drawn as a scene; they are listed separately and are NOT queued for image generation.
